records.name: RECIST (es)
records.text: El reglamento para medir si los tumores han crecido o disminuido en las exploraciones.

Theranostics (es)
records.text: Usar la misma molécula de guía para una exploración diagnóstica y una terapia, de modo que se trata exactamente lo que se ve.

records.name: Standardised uptake value (SUV) (es)
records.text: Un número que indica cuánto brilla un punto en un PET.

records.name: Dosimetry (es)
records.text: Medir cuánta dosis de radiación recibió realmente cada órgano y tumor de un fármaco radiactivo.

RECIST (zh)
records.text: 在影像上衡量肿瘤增大或缩小的规则手册。

records.name: PERCIST (PET response criteria in solid tumours) (zh)
Theranostics (zh)
records.text: 用同一靶向分子做诊断扫描和治疗，从而精确治疗所见之物。

records.name: Standardised uptake value (SUV) (zh)
records.text: PET上某个点亮度的数值。

records.name: Radioligand dosimetry (zh)
records.text: 根据每次给药后的扫描，测量放射性配体实际向肿瘤以及肾脏和骨髓递送了多少辐射，使治疗得以个体化。

records.name: Dosimetry (zh)
records.text: 测量每个器官和肿瘤从放射性药物实际接受的辐射剂量。

records.name: Quantitative imaging biomarkers (RECIST, PERCIST, SUV, ADC) (zh)
records.text: 从扫描中提取、用来判断癌症是缩小、增大还是坏死的数字：RECIST 的肿瘤直径、PET 的糖摄取、MRI 的水分子运动；它们支撑着每一项试验和大多数临床决定，而其可靠程度取决于扫描的做法。

records.name: RECIST (pt)
records.text: O livro de regras para medir se os tumores cresceram ou encolheram nos exames.

records.name: PERCIST (PET response criteria in solid tumours) (pt)
Theranostics (pt)
records.text: Usar a mesma molécula de mira para um exame diagnóstico e uma terapia, de modo a tratar exatamente o que se vê.

records.name: Standardised uptake value (SUV) (pt)
records.text: Um número para quão intensamente um ponto acende em um PET.

records.name: Dosimetry (pt)
records.text: Medir quanta dose de radiação cada órgão e tumor realmente recebeu de uma droga radioativa.

records.name: Quantitative imaging biomarkers (RECIST, PERCIST, SUV, ADC) (pt)
RECIST (hi)
records.text: स्कैन पर ट्यूमर बढ़े या सिकुड़े यह मापने की नियम-पुस्तिका।

records.name: PERCIST (PET response criteria in solid tumours) (hi)
Theranostics (hi)
records.text: निदान स्कैन और थेरेपी दोनों के लिए एक ही लक्षित अणु का उपयोग, ताकि ठीक वही उपचारित हो जो दिखता है।

records.name: Standardised uptake value (SUV) (hi)
records.text: PET स्कैन पर कोई बिंदु कितना चमकता है इसकी संख्या।

records.name: Dosimetry (hi)
records.text: मापना कि रेडियोधर्मी दवा से हर अंग और ट्यूमर को वास्तव में कितनी विकिरण खुराक मिली।

records.name: Quantitative imaging biomarkers (RECIST, PERCIST, SUV, ADC) (hi)
RECIST (fr)
records.text: RECIST est le règlement qui sert à mesurer, sur les examens d'imagerie, si les tumeurs ont grossi ou diminué.

records.name: PERCIST (PET response criteria in solid tumours) (fr)
Theranostics (fr)
records.text: Utiliser la même molécule de ciblage pour un examen d'imagerie diagnostique et pour un traitement, afin de traiter exactement ce que l'on voit.

records.name: Standardised uptake value (SUV) (fr)
records.text: La valeur de fixation normalisée (SUV) est un nombre indiquant l'intensité avec laquelle un foyer s'illumine sur une TEP.

records.name: Dosimetry (fr)
records.text: Mesurer la dose de rayonnement que chaque organe et chaque tumeur ont réellement reçue d'un médicament radioactif.

records.name: Quantitative imaging biomarkers (RECIST, PERCIST, SUV, ADC) (fr)
RECIST (de)
records.text: RECIST ist das Regelwerk, nach dem auf Bildgebungsaufnahmen gemessen wird, ob Tumoren gewachsen oder geschrumpft sind.

records.name: PERCIST (PET response criteria in solid tumours) (de)
Theranostics (de)
records.text: Dasselbe zielsuchende Molekül wird für eine diagnostische Bildgebung und für eine Therapie verwendet, sodass genau das behandelt wird, was man sehen kann.

records.name: Standardised uptake value (SUV) (de)
records.text: Der standardisierte Aufnahmewert (SUV) ist eine Zahl dafür, wie hell ein Herd in einem PET-Scan aufleuchtet.

records.name: Dosimetry (de)
records.text: Die Messung, wie viel Strahlendosis jedes Organ und jeder Tumor tatsächlich von einem radioaktiven Medikament erhalten hat.

records.name: Quantitative imaging biomarkers (RECIST, PERCIST, SUV, ADC) (de)
RECIST (ja)
records.text: RECISTは、画像検査で腫瘍が大きくなったか小さくなったかを測るためのルールブックだ。

records.name: PERCIST (PET response criteria in solid tumours) (ja)
Theranostics (ja)
records.text: 同じ標的分子を診断のための画像検査と治療の両方に使うことで、画像で見えているものをそのまま治療できます。

records.name: Standardised uptake value (SUV) (ja)
records.text: 標準化取り込み値(SUV)は、PET検査で病変がどれほど明るく光るかを示す数値である。

records.name: Dosimetry (ja)
records.text: 放射性医薬品によって各臓器と腫瘍が実際にどれだけの放射線量を受けたかを測定すること。

records.name: Quantitative imaging biomarkers (RECIST, PERCIST, SUV, ADC) (ja)
RECIST (ar)
records.text: RECIST هو دليل القواعد المستخدم لقياس ما إذا كانت الأورام قد كبرت أو تقلصت في صور الفحص.

records.name: PERCIST (PET response criteria in solid tumours) (ar)
Theranostics (ar)
records.text: استخدام الجزيء الموجِّه نفسه في فحص تصويري تشخيصي وفي العلاج، بحيث تعالج بالضبط ما يمكنك رؤيته.

records.name: Standardised uptake value (SUV) (ar)
records.text: قيمة الامتصاص المعيارية (SUV) هي رقم يعبّر عن مدى سطوع بقعة ما في فحص PET.

records.name: Dosimetry (ar)
records.text: قياس مقدار الجرعة الإشعاعية التي تلقّاها فعليًا كل عضو وكل ورم من دواء مشعّ.

records.name: Quantitative imaging biomarkers (RECIST, PERCIST, SUV, ADC) (ar)
Immuno-PET (simple)
records.text: A labelled antibody or antibody fragment is traced in the body. Access, binding and clearance affect the image; treatment benefit needs separate evidence.

records.name: Mammography & tomosynthesis (simple)
records.text: Low-dose X-rays show breast patterns. Images reconstructed from several angles are computed sections, rather than removed tissue viewed under a microscope.

records.name: MRI (simple)
records.text: A magnetic field and radio waves make tissue images. Breast screening is one selected use. Enhancement and image volume do not count living cancer cells.

records.name: PET (positron emission tomography) (simple)
records.text: This scan shows where a named radioactive tracer goes. Normal tissues and disease can contribute signal; uptake does not count cancer cells.

records.name: FDG PET (simple)
records.text: This scan uses a radioactive glucose analogue. Normal tissues, inflammation and some cancers take it up, so a bright area is not a cancer diagnosis.

records.name: RECIST (simple)
records.text: The rulebook for measuring whether tumours have grown or shrunk on scans.

records.name: PERCIST (PET response criteria in solid tumours) (simple)
Theranostics (simple)
records.text: Using the same targeting molecule to scan for a cancer and then to treat it.

records.name: Ultrasound (simple)
records.text: Sound echoes make an image of a selected region and can guide a needle. The image does not establish the cell type or rule out all cancer.

records.name: Standardised uptake value (SUV) (simple)
records.text: A number for how brightly a spot lights up on a PET scan.

records.name: Radioligand dosimetry (simple)
records.text: Radioligand dosimetry measures from scans taken after each dose how much radiation a radioligand actually delivers to the tumour, kidneys and marrow, so treatment can be personalised.

records.name: Dosimetry (simple)
records.text: Measuring how much radiation each organ and tumour actually received from a radioactive drug.

records.name: Quantitative imaging biomarkers (RECIST, PERCIST, SUV, ADC) (simple)
records.text: Quantitative imaging biomarkers are the numbers pulled from scans, such as tumour diameters or sugar uptake on PET, that decide whether a cancer is shrinking or growing.

records.name: PET/CT (simple)
records.text: This examination combines a tracer-distribution image with X-ray anatomy. Uptake, location and scan conditions are interpreted together.

Quantitative imaging extracts measurements such as lesion dimensions or tracer uptake from scans. Their accuracy, interpretation and clinical usefulness require different evidence.
PET/CT combines a named tracer-distribution image with X-ray anatomy. Uptake, anatomy and the scan conditions are interpreted together; a hot spot does not by itself identify malignant cells.

Granzyme B imaging uses a radioactive tracer to study an enzyme released by cytotoxic immune cells. Early studies show feasibility and response associations; they do not validate choosing or stopping treatment from a scan.
A labelled antibody or antibody fragment is traced in the body. Access, binding and clearance affect the image; treatment benefit needs separate evidence.
Low-dose X-rays show breast patterns. Images reconstructed from several angles are computed sections, rather than removed tissue viewed under a microscope.
A magnetic field and radio waves make tissue images. Breast screening is one selected use. Enhancement and image volume do not count living cancer cells.
This scan shows where a named radioactive tracer goes. Normal tissues and disease can contribute signal; uptake does not count cancer cells.
This scan uses a radioactive glucose analogue. Normal tissues, inflammation and some cancers take it up, so a bright area is not a cancer diagnosis.
The rulebook for measuring whether tumours have grown or shrunk on scans.
iRECIST provides trial-data rules for unconfirmed and confirmed progression during immunotherapy. An iUPD label does not prove pseudoprogression or automatically permit continued treatment.
PERCIST 1.0 is a proposed FDG-PET response framework using lean-body-mass-normalised uptake. Its response rule needs more than a percentage change alone.
Using the same targeting molecule to scan for a cancer and then to treat it.
Sound echoes make an image of a selected region and can guide a needle. The image does not establish the cell type or rule out all cancer.
A number for how brightly a spot lights up on a PET scan.
Radioligand dosimetry measures from scans taken after each dose how much radiation a radioligand actually delivers to the tumour, kidneys and marrow, so treatment can be personalised.
Measuring how much radiation each organ and tumour actually received from a radioactive drug.
Quantitative imaging biomarkers are the numbers pulled from scans, such as tumour diameters or sugar uptake on PET, that decide whether a cancer is shrinking or growing.
This examination combines a tracer-distribution image with X-ray anatomy. Uptake, location and scan conditions are interpreted together.

Granzyme B imaging uses a radioactive tracer to study an enzyme released by cytotoxic immune cells. Early studies show feasibility and response associations; they do not validate choosing or stopping treatment from a scan.
